| description = Tranixx Darkpaw will randomly spawn in place of Fippy Darkpaw in the newbie area in front of North Qeynos.

He shouts a threat to the zone and then charges the Qeynos gate, only to be killed off by the guards outside.

He also appears on the top floor of Blackburrow, pathing between the Zoneline to Qeynos Hills, the cave to the left behind the pitfall treestump, and through the hallway nearby the Everfrost zoneline.

Based on the pathing, it's believed his placeholder is the Giant Plague Rat in the same zone on the top floor of Blackburrow.
